Diagnostic secret collection includes token-bearing webhook URLs and any settings key named url or ending _url. Connector, log and export directory roots fail closed when linked; unreadable log entries are no longer silently omitted. Exports use unique create-new files to avoid overwriting an earlier redacted copy. Windows junction and repeat-export fixtures pass; diagnostics suite passed 14/14. Non-settings secret sources and native export remain open.
